memory_candidates.content: index-entries.json only carries line_count entries for paths under context/** in this agent-system source store; rules/**, scripts/**, and hooks/** files have no index row and need no line-count maintenance when edited. Confirmed by querying .entries[] for rules/git-workflow.md (absent) vs context/standards/*.md (present and accurate).

When an implementing task's own research report or summary explicitly names a follow-up document as belonging to a specific successor documentation-parity task (e.g. 'this page belongs to task X by its description'), that note is a reliable signal the successor's file_scope should be widened at plan time even when the task description's own literal file list omits it.
